messages:
Anika (PM): heads-up — we're trying to land a minimal compliance acceptance checklist for the next beta. need quick async decisions on tradeoffs: audit export latency vs retention granularity, BYOK handshake timing, and SOC2 evidence packaging. propose a table of must-have vs nice-to-have.
Rui (Eng): +1. can we scope an MVP that supports daily audit exports (48h SLA) and per-tenant retention toggles later? daily export keeps infra simple.
Sam (Security): daily export seems risky for customers who need timely evidence. can we commit to <6h for high-tier customers and daily for others?
Anika (PM): suggestion: gate 6h SLA to Dedicated / Enterprise customers. keep daily export for self-serve. ops cost tradeoff noted. @Rui does runtime support per-tenant tiers?
Rui (Eng): runtime can do per-tenant retention flags but it adds index complexity. implementation estimate: 2 sprint effort for core, +1 sprint for optimistic rollback testing.
Priya (Legal): legal wants immutability metadata on exports + chain-of-custody header. also confirm we can provide export hashes for evidence.
Rui (Eng): hash-in-export is cheap (sha256) — no perf hit. adding immutability flags impacts storage layout though.
Jordan (SRE): ops note — hourly exports -> big spike on storage + egress. if we go <6h we should use incremental diffs (KV deltas) not full dumps.
Sam (Security): incremental diffs ok but must be signed and include retention-policy version id. customers can prove timeline.
Anika (PM): ok plan draft: MVP (phase 1) = daily audit export (48h SLA), per-tenant retention toggle UI flag (default 90d), BYOK onboarding API with manual ops approval, and SOC2 evidence bundle (manual pull). Phase 2 = 6h export for enterprise + signed diffs + automated BYOK handshake.
Rui (Eng): needs clarification: manual ops approval for BYOK means we block keys until ops flips a flag? what's SLAT for that step?
Priya (Legal): legal asks that BYOK activation requires documented acceptance (signed template) and retention policy mapping. ops approval can be part of onboarding checklist.
Jordan (SRE): if ops approves manually, we need a safe ramp to avoid backlog. recommend an automated pre-checker: key format & KMS reachable -> auto-approve for known cloud providers. manual only when pre-check fails.
Anika (PM): love that. reduces friction. add to acceptance criteria: auto-approve path for AWS/GCP KMS, manual fallback with 48h ops SLA.
Sam (Security): add to acceptance criteria: all audit exports must include: timestamped events, tenant id, model id, request_id, sha256 hash, and retention-policy-version.
Rui (Eng): for export format propose newline-delimited JSON compressed with gzip. example schema snippet: ```{\n  "ts": "2024-09-01T12:34:56Z",\n  "tenant_id": "t-123",\n  "req_id": "r-456",\n  "model": "redwood-7b-v1",\n  "event": "generate",\n  "meta": {"tokens": 23}\n}``` gzip + .ndjson works with our pipeline.
Priya (Legal): also include legal_hash = sha256(gzip_payload) in metadata. attachable to subpoenas.
Anika (PM): acceptance checklist (short):
- daily export (48h) ✅
- export schema stable v1 ✅
- export hashes included ✅
- BYOK onboarding API + auto-approve for AWS/GCP ✅
- manual ops fallback documented + 48h SLA ✅
- SOC2 evidence bundle manual endpoint (phase 1) ✅
- oncall runbook for export failures (pageable) — TODO
Rui (Eng): techncial todos:
- implement export generator + compression (1 sprint)
- sign/hash pipeline (0.5 sprint)
- retention toggle API + db schema (1 sprint)
- BYOK onboarding pre-checker (0.5 sprint)
Jordan (SRE): ops todos:
- oncall runbook (incidents + replays)
- automated alerting for export lag > 30% of SLA
- capacity plan for diffs vs full dumps
Priya (Legal): risk note: customers in regulated markets may need retention > 90d; ensure contract addenda path.
Anika (PM): decision asks: are we ok shipping with phase 1 acceptance checklist? thumbs if yes, please add any blocking concerns. @Sam @Rui @Priya @Jordan
Sam (Security): :thumbsup: ship phase 1, but add a flag for expedited export on subpoena/legal hold use-cases (manual trigger).
Rui (Eng): :thumbsup: from eng. small ask: include a feature flag to toggle signed diffs in case we need to roll back quickly.
Priya (Legal): :thumbsup: ship phase 1. require retention addendum flow documented.
Jordan (SRE): :thumbsup: ops aligned, will draft runbook.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly compliance sync tomorrow 09:00 PT — thread pinned.
Anika (PM): thanks team — I'll bake this into the roadmap doc and open a GH issue for the MVP acceptance checklist. I'll DM follow-ups for any outstanding details.
